solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Cede most of county, no doubt at first with hesitation

indicators.note: most of a word means all but its final letter is kept here

parts.note: Surrey is an English county south of London

indicators.note: at first asks for the opening letters of the words no and doubt

parts.note: er is the sound of hesitating in speech

explanation.surface: Giving up most of the county, hesitantly and with no doubt at first.
explanation.walkthrough: SURRE is Surrey, an English county, without its last letter; N and D are the first letters of 'no doubt'.
explanation.definitionFit: To surrender is to give up or hand over, the same as to cede territory.

clue.text: Clothing ornament from Kent area, one of five

parts.note: Kent lies in the SE, south-east England
a quin is one of quintuplets, five babies born together

explanation.surface: A dress decoration made in south-east England by one of quintuplets.
explanation.walkthrough: Kent is a county in south-east England, hence SE.
explanation.definitionFit: A sequin is a small shiny disc sewn onto garments as decoration.

clue.text: Period with first of Georges in control?

indicators.note: in says one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: a rein is a means of control, as in keeping a tight rein

indicators.note: first of asks for the opening letter of the next word

explanation.surface: An era when the first of the Georges held the throne.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface evokes the Georgian kings, fitting a royal period of rule.
explanation.definitionFit: A reign is the period during which a monarch rules.

clue.text: Old bird on a lake outside

parts.note: ex means former, as in an ex-wife
a tern is a seabird
L is a map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: An elderly seabird perched out on a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: External means on the outer side, the adjective sense of outside.

clue.text: Protest monster originally received in post

parts.note: a demon is a monster or fiend

indicators.note: in says the letter goes inside the post

parts.note: a post is a station, a place of duty

indicators.note: originally asks for the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A rally against a monster that has arrived by mail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'post' suggests mail, but it is STATION, a posting, with R placed 'in' it.
explanation.definitionFit: A demonstration is a public protest march or rally.

clue.text: Hurried to catch old horse

indicators.note: to catch means to hold, so this piece goes inside

parts.note: to run is to hurry, past tense ran

explanation.surface: Someone dashing to grab an aged horse.
explanation.definitionFit: A roan is a horse with a coat mixing white hairs with another colour.

clue.text: Long priestly vestment, a pound

parts.note: LB is the standard abbreviation for a pound in weight, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: A long clerical robe priced at one pound in a church sale.
explanation.definitionFit: An alb is the full-length white linen tunic worn by clergy at the Eucharist.

clue.text: Speak to daughter wearing a formal garment

indicators.note: wearing says the other piece is around this one, like clothing

parts.note: a dress here is formal attire, as in evening dress

explanation.surface: Talk to your daughter while she has on her smart frock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wearing' puts D inside A DRESS, the dress being worn by the daughter.
explanation.definitionFit: To address someone is to direct one's words to them.

clue.text: Unproductive peer, by the sound of it

indicators.note: by the sound of it says the word is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: a baron is a peer, a member of the nobility

explanation.surface: A lord who seems to achieve nothing, judging by what one hears.
explanation.walkthrough: 'peer' is a noble, BARON, said like the answer; 'by the sound of it' signals that.
explanation.definitionFit: Barren land or livestock yields nothing, so it is fruitless or unproductive.

clue.text: Item of bedding left outside back of hotel

indicators.note: outside says the first piece sits around the next one, enclosing it

parts.note: to quit is to leave, so left here stands for quit as a past tense

indicators.note: back of asks for the final letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: A guest abandons a bedcover behind the hotel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left' looks like a direction but is the verb: QUIT, which goes 'outside' the L that ends hotel.
explanation.definitionFit: A quilt is a padded bedcover, an obvious example of bedding.

clue.text: Stroll involving yours truly and that Cockney woman

parts.note: yours truly is a jokey way of saying me, the speaker
a Cockney drops the H, so her becomes 'er, giving ER

explanation.surface: A gentle walk shared by the narrator and a London woman.
explanation.walkthrough: A Cockney is a working-class Londoner whose accent drops initial H, so HER becomes 'ER. 'involving' is only a link here.
explanation.definitionFit: To meander is to wander slowly and aimlessly, much like a leisurely stroll.

clue.text: Uneducated rating on manoeuvres

indicators.note: troops on manoeuvres move about, so the letters of the words before it are moved into a new order

explanation.surface: A naval rating out on exercises is called unschooled.
explanation.walkthrough: A rating is a non-officer sailor in the Royal Navy; 'on manoeuvres' rearranges RATING ON.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone ignorant lacks knowledge or schooling, which is what uneducated describes.

clue.text: Unit of heredity a woman talked of

indicators.note: talked of says the word is to be heard spoken, giving a word of the same sound

parts.note: Jean is a common woman's name

explanation.surface: A woman is discussed as a unit of inheritance.
explanation.walkthrough: JEAN, the name, is said exactly like the biological term; 'talked of' signals the swap.
explanation.definitionFit: A gene is the basic unit by which inherited traits pass from parent to offspring.

clue.text: Elegant girl coming out and broadcasting?

parts.note: a deb, debutante, is a young woman making her debut in society
a programme being broadcast is on air

explanation.surface: A stylish debutante being shown on television?
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming out' is a debutante's entry into high society, so the girl is a DEB.
explanation.definitionFit: Debonair means suave and stylish, much the same as elegant.

clue.text: Callous governor lacking cultural pretensions

parts.note: HE stands for His Excellency, the title of a colonial governor
artless means simple and unaffected, without artistic airs

explanation.surface: A hard-hearted governor who has no time for the arts.
explanation.walkthrough: HE, His Excellency, is the style used for a governor or ambassador.
explanation.definitionFit: Heartless and callous are synonyms: both mean unfeeling and cruel towards others.

clue.text: A woman's token of matrimony? Something fishy here

parts.note: her is the possessive for a woman
a wedding ring symbolises marriage

explanation.surface: A woman's wedding band seems suspicious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Something fishy' suggests a suspicious matter, a red herring perhaps; here it is literally a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A herring is a fish, so it is literally a fishy thing.

clue.text: Confer privilege finally on street in East London area

indicators.note: in says these letters are placed inside the district

parts.note: Bow is a district in the East End of London

indicators.note: finally asks for the last letter of the word before it

explanation.surface: Granting a privilege on a road in the East End.
explanation.walkthrough: Bow is an East End district of London; E and ST go 'in' it.
explanation.definitionFit: To bestow is to confer or grant something, such as an honour.

clue.text: About to pop off, collecting duke's golfing attendant

indicators.note: collecting says these letters are taken inside

parts.note: CA, short for circa, means about
to pop off is slang for to die
D is an abbreviation for duke

explanation.surface: A golf bag-carrier near death after picking up a duke's kit.
explanation.definitionFit: A caddie carries a golfer's clubs and offers advice on the course.

clue.text: Long to ignore head and make money

indicators.note: ignoring the head of a word means its first letter is dropped

parts.note: to long for something is to yearn for it

explanation.surface: Someone desperate to forget the boss and just bring in cash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Long' looks like an adjective but is the verb YEARN, which loses its head Y.
explanation.definitionFit: To earn is to receive money in return for work, which is making money.

clue.text: Prospect of girl coming between Dad and Mum

indicators.note: coming between says this piece is set inside, separating the other two

parts.note: Pa is an informal word for father
Ma is an informal word for mother
Nora is a girl's name

explanation.surface: The chance of a daughter wedging herself between her parents.
explanation.definitionFit: A panorama is a wide view, and a prospect in older usage is an extensive scenic view.

clue.text: A scam involving first of ripe fruit

indicators.note: involving says the letter is wrapped up inside

parts.note: a con is a scam or swindle

indicators.note: first of asks for the opening letter of the word after it

explanation.surface: A swindle centred on ripe produce.
explanation.definitionFit: An acorn is the nut of the oak, which botanists class as a fruit.

clue.text: Leaders of Great Ormond Street Hospital? I say!

indicators.note: leaders of a group of words are their first letters

explanation.surface: An exclamation at the famous London children's hospital.
explanation.walkthrough: Great Ormond Street Hospital is a famous London children's hospital, often called GOSH.
explanation.definitionFit: Gosh is a mild exclamation of surprise, like the British I say!

clue.text: African capital's crude oil used on excursion

parts.note: an excursion is a trip or outing

indicators.note: crude means raw and unrefined, so these letters are put into rough new order

explanation.surface: A North African city whose crude oil is shipped on a jaunt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crude oil' reads as petroleum, apt for Libya, but 'crude' is the anagram signal working on the word oil alone.
explanation.definitionFit: Tripoli is the capital city of Libya, on the North African coast.

clue.text: Steer clear of a chasm

parts.note: a chasm is a vast gap, a void

explanation.surface: Keep away from a gaping drop.
explanation.definitionFit: To avoid something is to keep away from it, the sense of steering clear.

clue.text: Toupee, one adopted by Grace initially

indicators.note: adopted by says the piece is taken in, placed inside the other

parts.note: W.G. Grace was the famous bearded English cricketer, so his initials are W and G
the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: A hairpiece taken up by the cricketer Grace in his early days.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' looks like a first-letter signal but means his initials: WG. W.G. Grace was a Victorian English cricketer.
explanation.definitionFit: A toupee is a small hairpiece covering a bald patch, a kind of wig.

clue.text: Obstacle rocking inn hard by church

indicators.note: rocking shakes these words about, so their letters are rearranged

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A barrier shaking the pub, with heavy work beside the church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rocking' looks like a description of the inn but signals that the letters of 'inn hard' are mixed up.
explanation.definitionFit: A hindrance is anything that holds you back, so it is an obstacle or impediment.
